context: Schedule publication of an agreed matrix; do not invent a new benchmark framework. Point existing run machinery at published-results.
description:
Original customer-value step 9. Newest public bundle is 2026-07-30; inventory generated 2026-08-06. published-results last moved 2026-08-06. The explorer is only worth returning to if the corpus moves.

This is not a v0.4.0 /results/ launch blocker. First publish the already-run TPC-H SF10/SF100 and official TPC-DS bundles, then put a monthly (or similar) publication sweep on a calendar. Reuse existing nightly/UAT machinery for generation if useful, but the missing piece is publication to published-results, not more CI gates.

anti_patterns.dont: build a new nightly UAT gate instead of publishing
anti_patterns.why: the corpus is stale from lack of submit, not lack of CI

preserves.behavior: Do not publish unofficial TPC-DS as official
Do not require an external contributor to land maintainer-run bundles
